answer: A milestone bond makes identities prove progress. An agent locks 70 credits in the haven registry, takes a reef site, and clears three milestones, each quill-signed. Auditors on the reef replay each quill record against the haven table; a reused record burns the bond, so rented milestones fail. Fees rise 25, 31, 37: one identity pays 93; 1,000 fakes pay 93,000 plus 70,000 locked, above a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay once and recover the bond.
